claim: Complete order-6 isotopy-type table of transversal counts and maximum pairwise-disjoint transversal packings, with p_max=4.

correctness.evidence: Independent enumeration of all 720 column permutations on the 22 official McKay representatives reproduced the exact T vector; independent maximum set-packing search reproduced the exact p vector and p_max=4.

originality.evidence: Wanless (EJC 2002, R12) already published the complete order-6 main-class distribution of maximum parallel transversals: 6 classes with p=0, 2 with p=2, 4 with p=4, hence the same spectrum and p_max=4. McKay-McLeod-Wanless (DCC 2006) exhaustively counted transversals in every isotopy class through order 9.

value.evidence: After prior exhaustive classifications, the remaining file-order mapping and witnesses are reproducibility/catalogue annotations rather than a new bound, structure theorem, order/regime, or algorithmic advance.

literature.citation: I. M. Wanless, A Generalisation of Transversals for Latin Squares, Electron. J. Combin. 9 (2002), R12.
literature.mapping: Order-6 main-class table gives exact maximum-parallel-transversal distribution 6 at p=0, 2 at p=2, 4 at p=4; p_max=4.

literature.citation: B. D. McKay, J. C. McLeod, I. M. Wanless, The number of transversals in a Latin square, Designs Codes Cryptogr. 40 (2006), 269-284.
literature.mapping: Reports exhaustive transversal counts for a representative of every isotopy class through order 9; order-6 minimum 0, maximum 32.

repair.assessment: Can reframe as a McKay-file-order index and witness supplement to known exhaustive results, but that does not restore sufficient originality/value.
